text_block_list.text:
Seeing how exhausted Mayano Top Gun was, I 
decided to take her to the infirmary to 
rest.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~, thanks for worrying about me! Maya 
is so well taken care of~☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to sleep tight! I hope I dream 
about you, Trainer-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh~? What is this place~? There are 
airplanes parked here~.

text_block_list.name: Flight Instructor
text_block_list.text:
—Cadet Mayano, here is your mission! Form 
a two-plane formation with Trainer, land 
on the beach... and ring the bell!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehh!? I get to ride on an airplane with 
you, Trainie!?
choice_data_list: Let's do our best together, Mayano!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay☆ Our lovey-dovey flight together, 
Trainer-chan... I'll definitely make it a 
success!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wah☆ Nice flight, Trainer-chan! Maya won't 
lose either~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: We're heeere☆
choice_data_list: Let's go ring the bell right away!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's do it together on three♪ 
Readyyyy... go!
(Ding-dong... ding-dong...)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? The nurse's office?? Aww, it was 
just a dream~.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that bell chime earlier was a 
bit..."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "...Ehehe! I hope it comes true someday~♪"

Having refreshed her spirits in her dream, 
Mayano Top Gun left the nurse's office 
with a light spring in her step.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh? We're losing altitude!? 
Eeeek—!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: —EMERGENCY~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Gasp!! ...W-Was that a dream?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Aww, man! It's frustrating even in a 
dream~~!

Unable to get the dream out of her head, 
Mayano Top Gun was unable to get enough 
rest...
